units.source_text: 我还想起那只挺立在屋顶顶端上长年经受风风雨雨的镀金铜凤凰。

en.t: I also remembered the gilded bronze phoenix that had stood upright on the peak of the roof, weathering wind and rain for many years.

units.source_text: 这只神秘的金鸟，不报时，也不振翅，无疑完全忘记自己是鸟儿了。

en.t: This mysterious golden bird did not announce the time or flap its wings; it had undoubtedly forgotten completely that it was a bird.

units.source_text: 但是，看似不会飞，实际上这种看法是错误的。

en.t: But although it seemed unable to fly, that view was in fact mistaken.

units.source_text: 别的鸟儿在空间飞翔，而这只金凤凰则展开光灿灿的双翅，永远在时间中翱翔。

en.t: Other birds fly through space, but this golden phoenix spreads its shining wings and soars forever through time.

units.source_text: 时间拍打着它的双翼，拍打了双翼之后，向后方流逝了。

en.t: Time beat against its two wings, and after striking them, flowed away behind it.

units.source_text: 因为是飞翔，凤凰只要采取不动的姿势，怒目而视，高举双翅，

en.t: Because this was flight, the phoenix needed only to assume a motionless posture, glare fiercely, and raise its wings high,

units.source_text: 翻卷着鸟尾的羽毛，使劲地岔开金色的双脚牢牢地站稳，这样就够了。

en.t: curl the feathers of its tail upward, spread its golden feet with all its strength, and stand firmly; that was enough.
